name: Viking 1 and Viking 2 Landers
summary: The Viking landers were the first American spacecraft to touch down safely and operate on Mars.
hook: We operated through the late 1970s and transmitted humanity first panoramic photographs of Mars.
how_it_worked: Powered by radioisotope thermoelectric generators (RTGs) with biological test chambers and meteorology booms.
science: Recorded weather cycles, analyzed soil chemistry, and observed seasonal frost forming on volcanic rocks.

facts.text: Viking 1 operated on the Martian surface for over six years (2,245 sols).
Viking 2 photographed winter frost made of water ice on Martian rocks in Utopia Planitia.

image.alt: First color image from Viking Lander 1 on the surface of Mars
